# dsh-google-classroom

Google Classroom tools for DeepSeek Harness,
served by the `google-classroom-mcp`
server. Once insta

lled, the model sees read-only tools such as
`mcp__google-classroom__list_courses` and `mcp__google-
classroom__list_due_soon`.

This is a configuration-only DSH bundle: a `package.json` with a
`dsh.bundle.patch` and a `cordis.pa

tch.yml` that inserts one
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` row. It ships no Host or Client code.
## Prerequisites

1. **A Google OAuth client for the Classroom API.** Follow
Google Classroom MCP — Setup
steps 1–3: c

reate an OAuth desktop client, save it as
`~/.google-classroom-mcp/client_secret.json`, and run the

one-time sign-in
(`uvx --from git+https://github.com/praisethefacts/google-classroom-mcp@v0.1.0 goog

le-classroom-mcp-auth`).
2. **uv** (provides `uvx`). Install from
astral.sh/uv or
`pip install uv`.

The bundle uses `uvx` to fetch and run the server on
demand, so no separate `pip install` is needed.

## Verify

Ask the model something like *"What do I have due this week?"* or call
`mcp__google-classroom__list_

courses`. The first tool call may be slow while
`uvx` downloads the server and its dependencies; lat

t tool call may be slow while
`uvx` downloads the server and its dependencies; later calls are fast.

If every tool call returns
`No valid Google credentials found...`, the one-time sign-in has not run

yet —
see Prerequisites. Google API errors naming scopes mean the OAuth consent
screen was not autho

rized with the read-only Classroom scopes; delete
`~/.google-classroom-mcp/token.json` and sign in a

with the read-only Classroom scopes; delete
`~/.google-classroom-mcp/token.json` and sign in again.

DSH scrubs ambient variables whose names look like credentials
(`KEY`, `PASSWORD`, `SECRET`, `TOKEN`

) before launching stdio children, so
this bundle relies on the token files under `~/.google-classro

om-mcp/`, never
on environment variables.
## Tools
All tools are read-only:
| Tool | Returns |

| `list_courses` | Courses you teach or attend |
| `get_course` | One course with description and en

rollment code |
| `list_coursework` | Assignments, quizzes, questions and materials, with due dates

|
| `list_due_soon` | Upcoming coursework across all active courses |
| `list_announcements` | Recen

t announcements in a course |
| `list_teachers` / `list_students` | Rosters (name, email) |
| `list_
submissions` | Submission state and grades for one assignment |
